story_description: Users launching Blaze for the first time need guided onboarding that detects installed AI CLIs, offers one-click installation for missing ones, and configures the environment automatically so they can start coding immediately.
task_description: Implement the final onboarding completion screen that displays a success animation, summarizes installed CLIs and configured components, persists the onboarding completion flag, and offers paths to start using Blaze immediately or launch an interactive tutorial.
atom: Completion Screen with Summary and Tutorial Launch
atom_description: A SwiftUI view that celebrates successful onboarding completion with an animated success state, displays a summary of all installed CLIs and configured settings from previous screens, persists hasCompletedOnboarding to UserDefaults, triggers installation of any queued items, and provides two exit paths: Close to dismiss and start using Blaze, or Start Tutorial to launch the guided tour overlay.
problem_statement: After completing all onboarding steps, users need clear confirmation that setup succeeded, a summary of what was configured, and a smooth transition to using the app. Without a proper completion screen, users may be uncertain whether onboarding finished correctly or feel abruptly dumped into the main app without context on what to do next.
scope_in: Display animated success indicator when screen appears (checkmark with spring animation)
Show summary section listing all installed CLIs from OnboardingState with version numbers
Show summary section listing configured settings (theme choice, permissions granted)
Show summary section listing installed starter packs or prompt libraries if any
Display personalized welcome message using userName from OnboardingState
Persist hasCompletedOnboarding = true to UserDefaults/@AppStorage on view appear
Trigger background installation of any queued items (starter packs, prompt libraries)
Provide Close button that dismisses onboarding and reveals main app ContentView
Provide Start Tutorial button that dismisses onboarding and activates TutorialOverlayView
Add confetti or celebratory animation that respects accessibilityReduceMotion
Track screen view and button taps via telemetry events
scope_out: Actual implementation of TutorialOverlayView - separate atom handles tutorial infrastructure
Deep configuration of installed CLIs - handled in subsequent first-run flows
Account creation or cloud sync setup - future feature not in MVP
Walkthrough of specific Blaze features - deferred to tutorial overlay
Recovery flow if onboarding was incomplete - handled by OnboardingCoordinator guard
assumptions: OnboardingState is populated with detection results and configuration choices from prior screens
TutorialOverlayView exists and can be triggered via showTutorial binding
Main app ContentView is ready to be shown when onboarding dismisses
UserDefaults can persist hasCompletedOnboarding flag reliably
Animation system supports spring animations and conditional reduced motion
constraints: Must not block UI thread during background installation of queued items
Must complete flag persistence before allowing Close action to prevent re-showing onboarding
Must gracefully handle empty state if user skipped all optional screens
Animation must complete within 2 seconds to avoid feeling sluggish
Screen must be accessible with VoiceOver including summary item announcements
functional_requirements: FR1: On view appear, immediately set hasCompletedOnboarding = true in @AppStorage
FR2: Display animated checkmark success indicator with spring animation scale 0.5 to 1.0 over 0.6 seconds
FR3: Show optional confetti animation that auto-dismisses after 3 seconds, respecting accessibilityReduceMotion
FR4: Display summary card titled 'Ready to Code' with list of installed CLIs showing name and version
FR5: Display summary card titled 'Your Settings' with configured theme, permissions, and preferences
FR6: Display summary card titled 'Installed Packs' with any starter packs or prompt libraries selected (or hide if none)
FR7: Show personalized greeting 'Welcome, {userName}!' using OnboardingState.userName
FR8: Trigger OnboardingCoordinator.installQueuedItems() async on appear to process any pending installations
FR9: Close button dismisses onboarding full screen cover and transitions to main ContentView
FR10: Start Tutorial button dismisses onboarding and sets showTutorial = true to activate tutorial overlay
FR11: If queued installations fail, show non-blocking toast with retry option
FR12: Emit telemetry events for screen view, close tap, and tutorial tap with timing data
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Screen renders within 100ms of navigation to avoid perceived lag
NFR2: Success animation completes within 600ms with smooth 60fps rendering
NFR3: Background installations do not cause UI jank or dropped frames
NFR4: Summary cards render correctly with 1 to 10 items without scrolling issues
NFR5: VoiceOver reads summary items in logical order with proper grouping
NFR6: Memory footprint stays under 30MB including animation assets
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create CompletionOnboardingView.swift file with struct conforming to View protocol
Step 2: Add @AppStorage property wrapper for hasCompletedOnboarding Bool flag
Step 3: Add @EnvironmentObject for OnboardingState to access detection results and settings
Step 4: Add @Binding properties for isPresented (dismiss onboarding) and showTutorial (activate tutorial)
Step 5: Create CompletionViewModel class with @Published properties for installationProgress and installationError
Step 6: Implement success checkmark view using SF Symbol checkmark.circle.fill with scale animation modifier
Step 7: Create ConfettiView using Canvas and TimelineView for particle animation respecting reduceMotion
Step 8: Build SummaryCard reusable view with title String and items array of SummaryItem (icon, text)
Step 9: Create CLISummaryCard that maps OnboardingState.detectedCLIs to SummaryItems with version text
Step 10: Create SettingsSummaryCard that extracts theme choice and permissions from OnboardingState
Step 11: Create PacksSummaryCard that shows installed starter packs or returns EmptyView if none
Step 12: Implement personalized greeting text view with userName interpolation and fallback
Step 13: Add onAppear modifier that sets hasCompletedOnboarding = true
Step 14: Add task modifier that calls viewModel.installQueuedItems() for background installation
Step 15: Create CloseButton view with 'Get Started' label and action dismissing isPresented
Step 16: Create TutorialButton view with 'Start Tutorial' label and action setting showTutorial true then dismissing
Step 17: Implement toast overlay for installation errors with retry button
Step 18: Add telemetry calls in onAppear, CloseButton action, and TutorialButton action
Step 19: Compose all views in body with VStack layout, proper spacing, and scroll view wrapper
Step 20: Add accessibility modifiers including accessibilityLabel for summary cards and button hints
Step 21: Wire CompletionOnboardingView into OnboardingRootView navigation flow as final step
Step 22: Write unit tests for CompletionViewModel installation logic
Step 23: Write UI tests for summary rendering and button actions
data_model_changes: Add SummaryItem struct with fields: icon (String SF Symbol name), title (String), subtitle (String optional) for summary card rows
Add CompletionState enum: loading, ready, installingQueued, completed, error(String) for view state management
Extend OnboardingState with computed property summaryItems: [SummaryItem] aggregating all configured items
Add InstallationResult struct with fields: itemName (String), success (Bool), error (String optional)
api_contracts: OnboardingCoordinator.completeOnboarding() -> Void - finalizes onboarding state and transitions out
OnboardingCoordinator.launchTutorial() -> Void - dismisses onboarding and activates tutorial overlay
OnboardingState.summaryItems: [SummaryItem] - computed property returning all summary data
event_contracts: OnboardingEvent.completionScreenViewed - emitted when completion screen appears
OnboardingEvent.onboardingCompleted(duration: TimeInterval, cliCount: Int, packsCount: Int) - emitted after hasCompletedOnboarding set
OnboardingEvent.completionClosePressed - emitted when user taps Close/Get Started button
OnboardingEvent.completionTutorialPressed - emitted when user taps Start Tutorial button
OnboardingEvent.queuedInstallationStarted(itemCount: Int) - emitted when background install begins
OnboardingEvent.queuedInstallationCompleted(successCount: Int, failureCount: Int) - emitted when install finishes
OnboardingEvent.queuedInstallationRetried - emitted when user retries failed installations
ui_states: Initial state: Success animation playing, summary cards loading
Ready state: Animation complete, summary cards displayed with data, buttons enabled
Installing state: Background installation in progress, subtle progress indicator in corner
Completed state: All installations done, full summary visible, ready to dismiss
Error state: Toast overlay showing installation failures with retry option
ui_interactions: View appear triggers success animation and hasCompletedOnboarding persistence
Confetti animation plays automatically and dismisses after 3 seconds (skipped if reduceMotion)
Tap Close/Get Started button dismisses onboarding and shows main app
Tap Start Tutorial button dismisses onboarding and activates tutorial overlay
Tap Retry in error toast retries failed background installations
Scroll vertically if summary content exceeds visible height
ui_copy: You're ready to start coding with AI
edge_cases: User skipped all optional screens - show minimal summary with just detected CLIs
No CLIs were detected or installed - show message suggesting to install one from settings
userName is empty or nil - use generic greeting 'Welcome!' without name
All queued installations fail - show error toast but do not block Close action
OnboardingState is nil or corrupted - show error state with option to restart onboarding
Device in low power mode - skip confetti animation to conserve resources
Screen appears via deep link or restoration - re-check hasCompletedOnboarding before showing
failure_modes: UserDefaults write fails - retry with exponential backoff, alert if persistent failure
Background installation task cancelled on dismiss - allow pending items to complete
Animation assets fail to load - fall back to static checkmark image
OnboardingCoordinator reference is nil - log error and allow manual dismiss
Memory pressure during confetti animation - gracefully degrade to no animation
Tutorial view not available - disable Start Tutorial button and show tooltip explaining
rollback_plan: If completion screen causes crashes or data corruption, revert to previous onboarding flow version. hasCompletedOnboarding flag can be reset via Settings > Developer > Reset Onboarding for users who experienced issues. Queued installations that failed can be retried from Settings > Installed Packs.

completed_when: The completion screen displays after all onboarding steps, shows an animated success state, presents accurate summary of installed CLIs and configured settings, persists the hasCompletedOnboarding flag to UserDefaults, and allows users to either dismiss to the main app or launch the tutorial overlay.
completed_evidence: Screen recording showing: 1) Navigation to completion screen with success animation playing, 2) Summary cards displaying detected CLIs with versions, 3) Tap on Get Started dismisses and shows ContentView, 4) Separate recording showing Start Tutorial activates overlay, 5) Test report with all unit and UI tests passing, 6) Console log showing hasCompletedOnboarding set to true.
dependencies: Requires OnboardingState populated from prior screens (Welcome, CLI Detection, Preferences, Starter Packs). Requires OnboardingCoordinator for navigation and completion handling. Requires TutorialOverlayView to exist for tutorial launch (can be stubbed initially). Requires BlazeApp integration with fullScreenCover and showTutorial bindings.
status_reason: Specification complete. Low risk as this screen has minimal external dependencies (primarily reads from OnboardingState) and straightforward UI requirements. Blocked by prior onboarding screens being implemented to provide state.
open_questions: Should confetti use system particle effects or custom Canvas implementation for better control
What specific starter packs will be available at MVP launch to include in summary
Should there be an option to re-run onboarding from settings for users who want to reconfigure
How long should the screen remain before auto-advancing if user takes no action
notes: This is the culmination of the onboarding flow and sets the emotional tone for first app usage. The success animation and summary should feel celebratory but not over the top. Consider A/B testing tutorial launch rate to optimize button copy and placement. Low risk atom as it primarily displays state collected by prior screens.

risks: UserDefaults write may fail in rare sandbox or disk full conditions
Background installation tasks may be cancelled if user dismisses too quickly
Confetti animation may cause frame drops on older hardware
OnboardingState may be incomplete if user force-quits during onboarding
mitigations: Implement retry logic for UserDefaults writes with user-visible error if persistent failure
Allow background tasks to complete even after view dismiss using detached task
Detect device capability and disable confetti on older Macs or when reduceMotion enabled
Validate OnboardingState on screen appear and show graceful fallback for missing data
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only Onboarding module completion flow. Does not modify core app functionality or existing session data. UserDefaults flag is isolated and can be reset without side effects.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If completion screen has critical issues, can bypass directly to ContentView by setting hasCompletedOnboarding = true from OnboardingCoordinator. Users can access tutorial separately from Help menu.

persistence: UserDefaults key 'hasCompletedOnboarding' (Bool) - marks onboarding complete to prevent re-showing
OnboardingState persisted via OnboardingCoordinator for summary data access
